title: TensorPlate Serving Metrics (JSON mode)
description:
Structured-JSON `/metrics` body produced by the serving worker when `metrics_mode = json`. The Prometheus 0.0.4 text-format body is also accepted as the default exposition; this schema is for agent-side scrapers that prefer machine-friendly bodies. Labels are bounded: the four required dimensions, and for a speech deployment the optional `row` and `mode`, which take only the values registered here. `outcome` and `stage` label one series, not a worker, so their registered values are under `definitions` for the property that will carry per-series labels; no property references them yet.

Latency histogram bucket boundaries (milliseconds, inclusive upper bound): 0.5, 1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 300, 500, 600, 1000, 1500, 5000, +Inf. A producer older than the 300, 500, 600 and 1500 boundaries reports the other eleven.

OutcomeLabel.description: How the counted session or request ended. `rejected` is a refusal before admission; an expiry or a timeout is `failed`.

StageLabel.description: Serving stage a duration covers, in pipeline order.

row.description: Speech model row the worker serves. Omitted for a deployment that is not one of the registered rows.

mode.description: Stream serving mode, as the bundle's speech block resolves it.

scheduler_in_flight.description: Scheduler logical in-flight count under its protocol 0.1 name, kept with this meaning (in_flight in scheduler_metrics.json). The same value as scheduler_in_flight_logical.

scheduler_in_flight_logical.description: Scheduler dispatched requests whose outcome is still open to the caller (in_flight_logical in scheduler_metrics.json).

scheduler_in_flight_physical.description: Scheduler dispatched requests the executor has not yet reported released, including requests cancelled while executing (in_flight_physical in scheduler_metrics.json). Omitted, never null, when the producer has no physical count.

scheduler_in_flight_physical_cancelled.description: Scheduler requests cancelled after dispatch that the executor has not yet reported released (in_flight_physical_cancelled in scheduler_metrics.json). Omitted, never null, when the producer has no physical count.
